Financing $100,000 at 6% APR for 60 months: $1,933.28 a month, $15,996.81 total interest, $5,519.05 interest in the first 12 months. With a $120,000 first-year deduction at a 30% rate, year-1 tax saving is $37,655.71, so year-1 net cash is $5,543.65. After-tax total cost over the loan: $95,197.77.

This is an estimate, not tax advice. Check Form 4562, its instructions and Pub. 946, or ask a tax professional before you file.
